newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan LDP urges extra budget by year-end -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan LDP urges extra budget by year-end -- paper.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's Liberal Democratic Party has proposed that the government adopt a supplementary budget for the current fiscal year by the close of 1996, a financial daily reported on Tuesday.

Senior members of the LDP submitted a proposal to the chief government spokesman urging the government to consider presenting the supplementary budget at an extraordinary diet session to be convened in late November and adopt it by the end of 1996, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said in its evening edition.
Senior LDP officials such as Taku Yamazaki and Koichi Kato had earlier been urging the government to adopt an extra budget when the regular diet session convened in January 1997.
Media reports have suggested that an extra budget, including economic stimulus measures, could amount to five trillion yen. The 1996/97 fiscal year ends next March.
